https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/345dc00d8caf9741052b543ad53607d1af6ab298.png

 More art assets
 Work on side missions
 New playable race, The Uhlanga.


We have also created a community discord! Join us and pester the devs directly, or chat with your fellow mercs.

Join: https://discord.gg/Xjmqngk

See you next week!

notes.title: Devlog 8/6/2019
notes.content:
Hello again mercs! 
Once again I have been working on art assets. Mainly for the NDF (Kasha) areas. Also started looking at integrating workshop support for the game. You can already make your own maps and missions, it would be even better if you could share them right? In the upcoming weeks I will be working on making a guide on how to use the editors.

Worked on:

 More assets, check out the attached screen!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/595386aeb5112f552b2085d298d8c94104dc8f45.png
 Looking at the needs for Steam Workshop support.


We have also created a community discord! Join us and pester the devs directly, or chat with your fellow mercs.

Join: https://discord.gg/Xjmqngk

See you next week!

notes.title: Devlog 7/31/2019
notes.content:
Hello Mercs!

I will now be posting a weekly devlog describing what I have been working on the past week. 

This week I have been working on creating assets for the next part of the main story, mostly NDF tiles since it will be NDF themed.

Worked on:

 Several new tile maps for NDF (Kasha) themed locations, Tiles for Prefab structures in the NDF style, both FG and BG tiles.
 New NDF weapon, the Flak Gun. A shotgun like weapon that fires ricocheting projectiles that rip though targets
 Glow system for map props, nice for fancy lights


See you next week!

notes.title: Update: Shadows of Anubis!
notes.content:
Proud to release a new update featuring a new Main Story area, The Anubis Tomb world!
After Talking to Thoriden, Leader of the Asguardians, he sends you to Anubis to find his friend, Tyr.

Explore the sprawling cryo-tombs looking for Tyr and treasure.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/752e372d5e22f1d96e48df81573bcc5b64a7f73a.png

Find amazing secrets.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/d88217d3ed95c1ebef755916bff19c2a7e20f272.png

And deal with the shadowy Osiris.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35122808/a5bb220629efac353bc6559bb1f2569555eda623.png

Changes:

 Finished the Anubis Tomb World
 New enemies
 New Items
 New Boss
 Various bug fixes


Steam Build: 4040355

notes.title: Open to Early Access
notes.content:
Today Identity Sector is released live into Early Access!

Join the Asgardian Mercenaries as they fight the Defensive Initiative.

We welcome all to join this adventure and help us improve this game as we listen to feedback and bug reports. Join the community hub and share your finds.

See you soon Merc!
